_doc: NONASK-1103 WP-E routing label set. Synthetic question texts only (no source text, no hosts). label = intended source route: technical (practitioner), scholarly, general. split = sha256(seed:cluster) parity (cluster-grouped so near-duplicate phrasings share a half), fixed before any tuning. ambiguous items are excluded from metrics and reported separately for the owner spot-check. SYNTHETIC FIXTURES; real-data calibration (plan 5b) still required before any flag flip. Labels are DRAFT: pending two-skeptic labelling on distinct models and an owner spot-check of >=10% (remediation-plan 5b); until then every metric is an offline fixture baseline.
